_doc: The alley cat (concept C2) was staged here until Dominic picked it. Since D-124 (2026-10-13, "rats ride cats") it is in play: its parts (body.cat, head.cat, leg.cat, leg.cat_hind) are in data/parts.json, the cat creature in data/creatures.json (the rats' mounts), its coats (cat_ginger, cat_tuxedo, cat_grey) in data/palettes.json and the words cat, cats, alley, alleycat in data/lexicon.json. The staged version is in git history (commit 2378061). Nothing loads this file.
